eyebrow: Intl Day of Persons with Disabilities
ar2: من برّا: «شكلك منيح». من جوّا: غسيل كل يومين.
en: Kidney failure is a disability you can't see. Outside: "you look fine". Inside: dialysis every other day.
qar: حدا قلّك «بس شكلك منيح»؟ جاوبني بالخاص.
qen: Did anyone tell you "but you look fine"? Reply in DM.
